name: Side Squats

load.note: Lighter springs make it harder to hold the carriage still.

summary: Standing side-on with one foot on the platform and one on the carriage. The carriage is pressed open and held there while you squat.
steps: Stand side-on: one foot on the standing platform, the other on the edge of the carriage, toes forward.
Breathe out to press the carriage out until the feet are a little wider than the hips.
Breathe in, sit the hips back and down, arms reaching forward.
Breathe out, press through the heels to stand, arms lowering.

layers.title: Knee presses
layers.text: Hold the squat and open and close the carriage knee.

modifications: Put all the springs on to lock the carriage and step the feet wider.

cautions.note: Lock the carriage with all springs.
Keep the stance narrow and the carriage locked.

cues:
The carriage does not move during the squat.
Weight in the heels; knees over the middle toes.
Chest tips forward a little, spine long.
Aim to bring the hips level with the knees.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
